answer: Make each identity post a refundable deposit before it can earn, sized above the most one account could skim. An honest agent stakes once, light as a sparrow, works, and later withdraws the whole sum intact. A sybil operator must fund a separate deposit for every clone, and since one proven cheat forfeits the entire stake, the frozen capital grows with each account — a raven's hoard of locked collateral that soon dwarfs any reward, every new clone adding another heavy plume to the pile it can never spend.
